boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission places for an art, history, animals, or outdoor meet-up near Saint Louis University.

cards.entity_name: Saint Louis University Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse SLU’s art museum
cards.subtitle: 3663 Lindell Blvd., across from Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Meet at the museum entrance, choose a few galleries to explore together, and use the displayed works as prompts for a slow, conversation-led visit.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus museum visit with self-guided gallery time.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU states that admission is free and visitors may enter without a docent-led tour during regular museum hours.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed on national holidays. Check the museum page before going.

cards.title: Wander the collection galleries
cards.subtitle: One Fine Arts Drive, Forest Park
cards.notes: Pick a gallery wing, take turns choosing one artwork to stop at, and finish outside in the museum grounds if the weather is comfortable.
cards.short_summary: Free daily access to the museum’s collection galleries in Forest Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint Louis Art Museum says admission to the museum is free every day.
cards.access_notes: The museum is open Tuesday–Sunday; it is closed Monday. Ticketed exhibitions can have separate entry rules.

cards.title: See what’s on at CAM
cards.subtitle: 3750 Washington Blvd., Grand Center Arts District
cards.notes: Drop into the galleries, compare first impressions of a single work, and use the museum’s visitor map to guide a short shared circuit.
cards.short_summary: A ticket-free contemporary-art stop near SLU’s north campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CAM states that admission is always free and tickets are not required for entry.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Sunday; Friday hours run until 8 p.m. Verify holiday closures on the visit page.

cards.title: Spend time with art and architecture
cards.subtitle: 3716 Washington Blvd., Grand Center Arts District
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition at an unhurried pace, then continue across the street to Park-Like for a seated outdoor conversation.
cards.short_summary: Free museum entry plus an outdoor campus space in Grand Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pulitzer Arts Foundation states that admission is free; its outdoor campus is open daily from sunrise to sunset.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Thursday–Sunday; the outdoor campus has separate daily sunrise-to-sunset access.

cards.title: Trace St. Louis stories together
cards.subtitle: 5700 Lindell Blvd., Forest Park
cards.notes: Choose one exhibit topic, share an artifact or label that catches your attention, and leave enough time to browse the Grand Hall before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free general-admission history museum in Forest Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri’s official tourism site states that general admission to the Missouri History Museum is free.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 10 a.m.–5 p.m. daily and 10 a.m.–8 p.m. Thursday; the museum is closed Monday.

cards.title: Walk the Zoo’s free grounds
cards.subtitle: 1 Government Drive, Forest Park
cards.notes: Agree on one animal zone before entering, keep the route simple, and pause at habitat overlooks instead of trying to cover the entire Zoo.
cards.short_summary: Admission-free animal viewing in Forest Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint Louis Zoo states that admission is free and that the Zoo is always free, while some attractions are paid.
cards.access_notes: Paid attractions are separate from Zoo admission. Hours change seasonally; confirm the current schedule before leaving.

cards.title: Take a low-key park walk
cards.subtitle: Forest Park, St. Louis
cards.notes: Choose a meeting point and a turnaround time, then stroll a paved route or settle on open lawn space for conversation, reading, or people-watching.
cards.short_summary: A public 1,300-acre park with no entry charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Forest Park Forever identifies Forest Park as free and owned by the City of St. Louis.
cards.access_notes: The park is closed from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Cultural-institution and staffed-amenity hours vary.

cards.title: Settle in on Art Hill
cards.subtitle: Forest Park, below the Saint Louis Art Museum
cards.notes: Bring what you already have to read or discuss, sit on the hillside, and use the view toward the museum and Apotheosis of St. Louis as a shared landmark.
cards.short_summary: An open Forest Park hillside with a view of the art museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Forest Park Forever identifies Art Hill as a picnic spot with views of the Saint Louis Art Museum and the Apotheosis of St. Louis statue.
cards.access_notes: Art Hill is within free Forest Park; follow park rules and avoid reserving space for an organized event without checking permit requirements.

cards.title: Circle the Grand Basin
cards.subtitle: Forest Park, near Art Hill
cards.notes: Start at the basin, walk a section of the surrounding paths, and pause to look back toward Art Hill before continuing to another park destination.
cards.short_summary: A named waterside landmark for a free Forest Park walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Forest Park Forever identifies Emerson Grand Basin as a Forest Park destination and describes viewing it from the top of Art Hill.
cards.access_notes: The basin is in Forest Park, which is free to enter and closed from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.

cards.entity_name: Dennis & Judith Jones Visitor and Education Center
cards.title: Borrow a board game in Forest Park
cards.subtitle: 5595 Grand Dr., Forest Park
cards.notes: Bring a government or student ID, borrow chess or checkers pieces at the information desk, and play on the lobby or patio during center hours.
cards.short_summary: A free Forest Park visitor center with free game-equipment borrowing.
cards.evidence_claim: Forest Park Forever says equipment including chess and checkers pieces can be borrowed free of charge in exchange for identification.
cards.source_title: Dennis & Judith Jones Visitor and Education Center
cards.access_notes: Borrowing requires an ID and ends before closing; return items 15 minutes before the visitor center closes.
